reviews.text: Terrible service. The hospitalization was completely questionable. They charge for a lot of medication but there's no guarantee it will even be administered.

The Vila da Penha unit is inoperative, with no return date, and when I scheduled an appointment via WhatsApp, the attendant didn't inform me of the situation. I woke up early, got my pet ready, and only found out when I arrived at the clinic door. A supreme lack of attention from the staff, and when I reported the lack of response, not even an apology. I wasted a good part of the morning and couldn't get treatment for my pet. A basic service!

The veterinarian is competent and attentive, but the clinic lacks proper facilities. And they call themselves a 24-hour emergency clinic.
My pet dislocated its pelvis on a Monday, and after a lot of struggle, they scheduled an X-ray for Thursday because they couldn't contact the person responsible.
In short, I looked for another clinic for the procedures.
I do not recommend them.

What this company does is completely against and violates our privacy because it conditions access to information about service prices on us registering by providing our CPF (Brazilian tax identification number). There is the General Data Protection Law which clearly states that this is illegal and that we are not obliged to provide our data just to obtain information. I sent an email requesting a statement from the clinic but, obviously, I was completely ignored, no response. How can a clinic like this, which does not respect its clients and blatantly ignores them, continue to operate? Do you want to sell our data, is that it? As far as I'm concerned, you can close or go bankrupt. You won't be missed.

Copy of the email sent:
Dear Sirs,

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the request for sensitive data such as my CPF at a time when I only sent a request for prices regarding the X-ray examination of my animal via WhatsApp.

I tried to explain to your attendant, by phone, that I hadn't yet decided whether to schedule the appointment, but it seems this is a recurring practice at your establishment, and he was inflexible, which I find unacceptable as it violates my rights and my privacy.
Although the clinic has the autonomy to apply its rules, I believe you should reconsider your position because it is primarily a matter of my right under the General Data Protection Law, as the legislation considers this to be data collection.
Furthermore, in marketing terms, such an attitude does not guarantee good publicity for your company.
I would very much like you to review your rules so that I can become a possible future client of your establishment.
Furthermore, I appreciate your attention and await your response regarding the matter presented.

Nilceia Serex
The veterinary care is wonderful, but the administrative service is terrible. I've been trying to contact them for over three days and no one has given me any feedback on my pet's test results.
The veterinarian was very attentive.

I didn't even get to go; I contacted them to find out the service cost, as I have a Pet Love plan and pay a co-payment, and the attendant, Peppa, couldn't tell me the price, only the private price. In all the units that serve Pet Love, they always inform me of the co-payment amount.
And the payment methods.

I think this information is the minimum we should have.
I suggested she find out, and I even got a sarcastic response!

The administrative side of the clinic is terrible. My cat died at the clinic after an emergency visit via Petlove. They offered cremation to my wife, and she said it was covered by her health insurance. They immediately said it wasn't covered and that she would have to pay privately or retrieve my cat's body. I called, tried to talk to them; my wife was alone, she's pregnant, and I was 450km away for work. I humbly asked them to keep the body until the morning when I could get the cremation paperwork sorted through Petlove, but they remained inflexible. My pregnant wife went home with the body of our beloved cat.

My advice: stay away from this clinic, because they have no love for what they do, they only want money.

Note: My wife loved the veterinarian, but the administrative staff were terrible at handling such a difficult situation.
I love your work, may God bless you all 🙏❤️ …
I am very grateful to Vet Ilha! They have always cared for my pet with so much love and dedication. Fast service, attentive veterinarians, and a welcoming environment. A trustworthy place!
Always received with great politeness and attention by the staff, excellent service. Our animals are very emotional and kind.

I have no complaints about the doctors I've seen on my visits there. But the WhatsApp service is very poor and very slow. And at the end, the person responsible for the service even asks if they can help more, but they didn't help at all, and were sarcastic in wishing me a great afternoon. They are not fit to work in customer service. Mr. Owner, fire this person. Despite the Vila da Penha unit being very close to my house, I will no longer have any tests done there. During the first appointment, they said the urine test results would be available in 48 hours. After 48 hours I asked again and then they said they had misread the results, it takes 5 to 7 days. Terrible.

Excellent service, attentive doctor, and the receptionist was very polite and helpful.
I highly recommend it.
Excellent clinic. Qualified professionals. Incredible prices too.
Best clinic in Rio, with the best prices in the region, I highly recommend it.

I didn't like the vet's service. My dog ​​was in extreme pain, and he was taking ages on the administrative tasks that are usually handled by reception. He was also incredibly rude. He didn't put me at ease.
My dog ​​received excellent care!
An excellent veterinary clinic. The receptionist and the doctor were very attentive to my four-legged son.
Excellent

I took my father's cat to this clinic and was delighted with the service and professionalism of Dr. Beatriz Soares, who explained everything clearly and objectively.
I thank her for all the care and attention.
During the appointment, it was clear how much love and patience she has for pets.
Congratulations to the clinic for having such an incredible professional.
Thank you!

Wow, I went to the clinic for an emergency and received excellent care from Lucas Miranda and Dr. Victor Jordan, who treated me exceptionally well, answering all my questions and caring for my cat with great affection. They deserve praise and I highly recommend them!

It was a great experience.
Lucas Miranda provided excellent service.
And the doctor was too.
Lucas was receptive and attentive. Congratulations to him and the entire Vet team.
Lucas Miranda is top-notch! 100% excellent service.
Thank you for the care provided by Rafael Corrêa and Dr. Beatriz, for the explanations and clarifications! I will return soon. Thank you.
I received excellent service at reception from Raphael Corrêa, and during the consultation from Dr. Victor.
I love the service at the clinic and the staff, especially the receptionist Raphael Correia.
I loved the service at the VET ILHA clinic; I was very well taken care of, especially by the receptionist Raphael Correia.
I highly recommend them, they are very attentive to our pets ❤️ And Raphael Correa's service is beyond words. Incredible...

I've taken my two cats there several times and they've always been very well treated by the veterinarians and staff at the clinic.

I especially thank the receptionist Raphael Corrêa for his kindness and attention during our last visit; I will certainly return many more times.
Top-notch environment, good facilities, excellent staff.
Excellent
Wonderful!
Excellent
The best, without a doubt! Price, quality, and attentive service!
